item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera wants to check whether the meals cooked at her home in Jaipur form a balanced diet for her family, which includes her young brother and her grandmother. What should she check to decide this?

options.A: that the meals fill everyone's stomach completely
options.B: that the meals contain many different food items on the plate
options.C: that the meals contain all essential nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts, suited to each person's age
options.D: that the meals taste good and are served hot
